messages.subject: facet_grid x-axis order
parts:
Hello
I am new to R and ggplot and hope someone can help me with the
following problem:

I want to make histogram of the factorial variable fLeiar7a (levels 0
to 7); one histogram for each of the levels in Leiar (3 levels). The
first line makes the graphs I want, except that the x-axis order is
not 0 to 7, but rater unlogical.

On the other hand, the second line makes the graph with correctly
ordered x-axis, so it seems that by calling facet-grid some reordering
occur. How can I avoid this?

Sincerely HaakonO


ggplot(medlem, aes(x=fLeiar7a, fill=Leiar7a), colour=fLeiar7a) +
geom_bar() + facet_grid(. ~ Leiar)

ggplot(medlem, aes(x=fLeiar7a, fill=fLeiar7a), colour=fLeiar7a) +
geom_bar()

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid x-axis order
parts:
Hi HakoonO,

In general, there are two ways to change the ordering of categorical variables:

* change the ordering of the factor levels
* use the levels argument of scale_x_discrete
(http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_discrete.html)

However, facet_grid shouldn't affect the order of the values, so I
would really appreciate it if you could send me a small reproducible
example so that I can look into it.

Thanks,

Hadley
